ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

2. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 144

4. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 20
   C. 9
   D. 1

5. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 12

6. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 11

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 43
   C. 31
   D. 49

8. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 48
   D. 49

9. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 32

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

11. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 64

12. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
